question:
In the following sentence, four words are underlined, out of which one word is MISSPELT. Select the MISSPELT word.

Everyone admired her because of her __charesma__, but she was a __narcissist__ full of __self-admiration__ and __treachery__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"charesma"** is incorrect and is likely a misspelling of the word "charisma". (चरिस्मा)

 
 
• **Example: **Her** charesma** captivated everyone in the room. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 
 
• **"Charisma"** refers to a special magnetic charm or appeal that can inspire devotion in others. (आकर्षण)
 
 
• **Example: **Her** charisma **made her a natural leader and beloved by all.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Treachery** (धोखा): Betrayal of trust; deceptive action or nature.

 
 
• **Example:** His treachery was revealed when he leaked confidential information to the competitors.
 
 
 
• **Self-admiration** (आत्म-प्रशंसा): The act of admiring oneself, especially in a self-congratulatory manner.
 
 
• **Example:** Her constant self-admiration made her unpopular among her colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Narcissist** (अहंकारी): A person who has an excessive interest in or admiration of themselves.
 
 
• **Example:** Being a narcissist, he always put his own needs above everyone else's.
